description: SEC going-concern check — Going-concern doubt screen from SEC EDGAR full text. ticker= (or cik=) checks a company's 10-K/10-Q/20-F filings over years= (default 3, max 10) and says whether its LATEST periodic report carries a going-concern paragraph: verdict GOING-CONCERN DOUBT (CURRENT) / RECENT / PRIOR / PRIOR DOUBT - LATEST REPORT CLEAN / MENTIONS ONLY / NO GOING-CONCERN LANGUAGE, with flagged filings and links. Omit ticker for a market-wide screen of companies whose filings in the last days= (default 30, max 90) contain going-concern wording; listed=1 keeps only companies with tickers, limit= up to 200. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_going_concern
